sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
General graduate admission accepts an accredited bachelor’s degree with program prerequisites and normally
GPA at least 3.0. UChicago degree is institutionally eligible once completed. Mathematics PhD is offered;
program-specific preparation thresholds were not retrievable. F-1 status does not itself establish a
degree/English exemption. [s2] [s3]
Before submission [Unresolved]
Use the University of Miami (Florida) graduate portal, select mathematics and check its 2027 schedule.
Request official transcripts and program-specific instructions from math@math.miami.edu before drafting or
ordering tests. Current department/Graduate School pages repeatedly returned access errors; the accessible
catalog and older mathematics flyer do not supply a complete checklist. [s1] [s2] [s4] [s5] [s18]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact faculty directly about research fit and availability; no pre-application supervisor-approval requirement
was verified. The shortlist below is based on official profiles/publications, but current full roster and associated
researchers’ PhD supervision roles need confirmation. [s7] [s8] [s9] [s10] [s12] [s13] [s15] [s17]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
The public portal distinguishes first-time, returning and UM-login users and points to a 2026/2027 application
schedule. No account was created; authenticated prompts and recommender controls were not inspected. [s4]
[s5]
Cycle verification [Unresolved]
A 2027 schedule selector is public; most retrievable mathematics logistics are undated or historical. This
dossier has substantial unresolved application-specific evidence because current pages were inaccessible. [s1]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Unresolved]
An exact final Mathematics PhD academic application deadline for Fall 2027 remains unverified. The public
Graduate Application Schedule offers separate 2026 and 2027 selectors, but its program rows did not render in
the public read. The department's undated graduate flyer gives funding-consideration dates, not a clearly
stated final academic closing date. [s1] [s5] [qbd2_d1] [qbd2_d2]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]

all fellowships, and by February 15 for teaching assistantships. These are standing published dates; their
application to Fall 2027 was not separately confirmed in a cycle-specific row. Plan around the earlier January 1
funding date while obtaining current-cycle confirmation. [s1] [qbd2_d1]

offer. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Unresolved]
Central policy requires official TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo results for non-native-English international applicants,
valid for two years. A mathematics-specific minimum, 2026 TOEFL scale and teaching-language requirement
were not retrievable. [s2]
UChicago English exemption [Unresolved]
A UChicago degree exemption for this on-campus PhD was not verified. An online-student handbook has
US-study exemptions, but it was not treated as binding on mathematics. Ask the mathematics/Graduate School
office whether completed or pending UChicago study qualifies and how to request approval. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Unresolved]
Central policy delegates entrance-test requirements to individual programs; tests, when required, must be
within five years. No current mathematics General/Subject GRE classification was verified. Do not copy
Medicine or Miami University (Ohio) policies. [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
Official mathematics flyer promises available PhD assistantships with full tuition waiver, health insurance and a
stipend, but gives no numeric stipend or paid-month count. A current 2027 amount, summer guarantee and
uncovered fees were not established. [s1]
Years of support; Conditions and duties; Extra funding application; Other funding routes
[Unresolved]
Department identifies fellowships and teaching assistantships; years of support, renewal rules, service load,
separate application/essay/reference requirements and other named awards remain unverified in accessible
public sources. [s1]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
The mathematics flyer explicitly states graduate assistantships are available to international students. [s1]
Application fee [Prior cycle]
Historical 2018-19 Graduate School handbook states $85 for graduate programs outside Music. Current
other-program pages also use $85, but no current mathematics-specific confirmation was retrieved; treat $85
as historical guidance, not a verified 2027 charge. [s6]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No current mathematics fee-waiver rule was verified. Medical-school waiver forms have a different scope and
must not be used as mathematics instructions. Ask math@math.miami.edu before payment. [s4] [s18]
